notes: VAT 18% (PwC); no investment-gold exemption - only supplies of gold to the Central Bank are zero-rated, so retail bullion and jewellery carry 18%. CBAR's 999.9 bullion coins (1/10-1 oz) are sold by agent banks (Bank of Baku, TuranBank) under Central Bank caps: sell at most gold price +10%, repurchase at gold price minus up to 3%; caps are not a dealer list, so premium fields are null.

sources.name: PwC Tax Summaries - Azerbaijan, Corporate - Other taxes
sources.what: The standard rate of VAT is 18%; zero rating covers the supply of gold and other valuables to the Central Bank of Azerbaijan, and no retail investment-gold exemption is listed. Customs duty rates vary between 0% and 15% depending on the type of goods, with no gold-specific rate stated. Imported gold and jewellery are excise goods, with rates set by the executive authority (not stated).

sources.name: Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan - Bullion coin sales agents
sources.what: CBAR has issued 999.9 gold bullion coins (1 ounce, 1/2 ounce, 1/4 ounce, 1/10 ounce) since 10 May 2023, sold and repurchased through agent banks Bank of Baku OJSC and TuranBank OJSC. Agents must set the selling price at the limit of 'gold price + 10%' and the repurchase price at 'gold price - up to 3%'.
